product.name: Lead Magnet Kit
product.note: Points at the ALREADY-BUILT lead-magnet-kit (verified live, 200). HONEST FIT: the kit's ebook/PDF layout templates and delivery setup transfer, but it was built for a free opt-in rather than a paid ebook — the script says 'layout templates and the delivery setup', never 'everything you need to sell'. DO NOT run commerce.
